verdict.rationale: Adyen In-Person Payments is a payment terminal/POS integration product, not an AI agent or agent-host platform; the story asks whether the product can consume external MCP servers as a client to gain new tools, which is not a fair capability question for this kind of product. The only MCP evidence available (adyen-pos-docs-13, adyen-pos-docs-20, adyen-pos-probe-4) shows Adyen exposing its own MCP server for LLM clients to call Adyen's APIs — the opposite direction — which does not make the client-consumption axis applicable.
